import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static final int maxn = 20;
    static int[][] a = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static int[] b = new int[maxn * maxn];
    static int[] mp = new int[1 << maxn * maxn];
    static int[] tot = new int[maxn];
    static List<Integer>[] v = new ArrayList[maxn];
    static int[] f = new int[2001000];
    static int[] g = new int[2001000];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static int pow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) ans = (int) ((long) ans * a % mod);
            a = (int) ((long) a * a % mod);
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int inv(int a) {
        return pow(a, mod - 2);
    }

    static int pc(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }

    static void reduce(int[] a, int[] b, int len) {
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            a[i] += b[i];
            if (a[i] >= mod) a[i] -= mod;
        }
    }

    static void fwt(int[] a, int lim) {
        if (lim == 1) return;
        int half = lim / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            int x = a[i], y = a[i + half];
            a[i] = x + y;
            if (a[i] >= mod) a[i] -= mod;
            a[i + half] = x - y;
            if (a[i + half] < 0) a[i + half] += mod;
        }
        fwt(a, half);
        fwt(Arrays.copyOfRange(a, half, lim), half);
    }

    static void fwt2(int[] a, int lim) {
        if (lim == 1) return;
        int half = lim / 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            int x = a[i], y = a[i + half];
            a[i] = x - y;
            if (a[i] < 0) a[i] += mod;
            a[i + half] = x + y;
            if (a[i + half] >= mod) a[i + half] -= mod;
        }
        fwt2(a, half);
        fwt2(Arrays.copyOfRange(a, half, lim), half);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int N = 2001000;
        int[] fArr = new int[N];
        int[] gArr = new int[N];

        for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i++) {
            v[i].clear();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                int val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
                a[i][j] = (int) ((long) val * inv(100) % mod);
                b[i * n + j] = a[i][j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            v[pc(i)].add(i);
            mp[i] = tot[pc(i)];
            tot[pc(i)]++;
        }

        int m = n / 2;
        int limit1 = 1 << (m * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < limit1; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < m * n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    p = (int) ((long) p * b[j] % mod);
                } else {
                    p = (int) ((long) p * (mod + 1 - b[j]) % mod);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[m]) {
                int[] s = new int[m];
                int totS = 0;
                int k = j;
                while (k != 0) {
                    s[totS++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k &= k - 1;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, totS);
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int idx = 0; idx < m; idx++) {
                        if (((S[idx] >> s[idx]) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        st |= 1 << mp[j];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s, 0, totS));
            }
            f[st] = (f[st] + p) % mod;
        }

        int M = n - m;
        int limit2 = 1 << (M * n);
        for (int i = 0; i < limit2; i++) {
            int p = 1;
            int[] S = new int[3];
            for (int j = 0; j < M * n; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    p = (int) ((long) p * b[j + n * m] % mod);
                } else {
                    p = (int) ((long) p * (mod + 1 - b[j + n * m]) % mod);
                }
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < M; j++) {
                S[j] = (i >> (j * n)) & ((1 << n) - 1);
            }
            int st = 0;
            for (int j : v[n - m]) {
                int[] s = new int[M];
                int totS = 0;
                int k = j;
                while (k != 0) {
                    s[totS++] = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(k);
                    k &= k - 1;
                }
                Arrays.sort(s, 0, totS);
                do {
                    boolean valid = true;
                    for (int idx = 0; idx < M; idx++) {
                        if (((S[idx] >> s[idx]) & 1) == 0) {
                            valid = false;
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    if (valid) {
                        int index = (~j) & ((1 << n) - 1);
                        st |= 1 << mp[index];
                    }
                } while (nextPermutation(s, 0, totS));
            }
            g[st] = (g[st] + p) % mod;
        }

        fwt(f, 1 << tot[m]);
        fwt(g, 1 << tot[m]);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << tot[m]); i++) {
            f[i] = (int) ((long) f[i] * g[i] % mod);
        }
        fwt2(f, 1 << tot[m]);
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << tot[m]); i++) {
            ans += f[i];
        }
        ans %= mod;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static boolean nextPermutation(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        int i = end - 2;
        while (i >= start && arr[i] >= arr[i + 1]) i--;
        if (i < start) return false;
        int j = end - 1;
        while (arr[j] <= arr[i]) j--;
        swap(arr, i, j);
        reverse(arr, i + 1, end);
        return true;
    }

    static void swap(int[] arr, int i, int j) {
        int tmp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = tmp;
    }

    static void reverse(int[] arr, int start, int end) {
        end--;
        while (start < end) {
            swap(arr, start++, end--);
        }
    }
}
